# jumpcloud_command (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud command (script that can be executed on devices).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_command" "example" {
  name         = "Security Posture Check"
  command      = <<-EOT
    #!/bin/bash
    echo "Checking security posture..."
  EOT
  command_type = "linux"
  user         = "root"
  sudo         = true
  shell        = "bash"
  trigger      = "periodic"
  schedule     = "0 9 * * 1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) The script or command to execute.
- `command_type` (String) The platform type: linux, mac, or windows.
- `name` (String) The name of the command.

### Optional

- `launch_type` (String) Launch type for the command.
- `schedule` (String) Cron schedule expression for periodic commands.
- `schedule_repeat` (String) Schedule repeat type: once, daily, weekly, or monthly.
- `shell` (String) Shell to use: bash, sh, zsh, or powershell.
- `sudo` (Boolean) Whether to run with elevated privileges.
- `timeout` (String) Command timeout duration.
- `trigger` (String) Trigger type: manual, automatic, deadline, or periodic.
- `user` (String) The user context to execute the command as. Defaults to root.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the command.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_command.example <command-id>
```
